sources.title: mehmetkeremturkcan/SAM3-Joint-Surgical · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Surgical SAM 3 is a SAM 3 image model trained jointly for detection and instance segmentation of surgical instruments, anatomy, and tissue from text prompts. The model uses one vocabulary across CholecInstanceSeg, CholecSeg8k, the Dresden Surgical Anatomy Dataset, and Endoscapes.

sources.title: mehmetkeremturkcan/SAM3-Joint-Surgical-Dataset - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The SAM3 Joint Surgical Dataset contains 41,372 physical images with 175,674 COCO annotations for surgical instruments, anatomy, and tissue. Its schema contains 29 categories and consolidates labels from CholecInstanceSeg, CholecSeg8k, the Dresden Surgical Anatomy Dataset, and Endoscapes.
